verdict.rationale: Plausible offers shareable dashboards (public/team shared links, embeddable dashboards) and a consolidated multi-site view, which lets a PM share analytics with a team, but there is no evidence of a 'saved insight' concept or the ability to compose multiple saved views/insights into a custom dashboard layout — Plausible's dashboard is a fixed single-page report per site rather than a composable dashboard builder. missing for 10: saved-insight objects, ability to arrange/compose multiple saved insights into a custom dashboard, evidence of multi-widget dashboard building.
